title: Cognitive Intervention for Children and Adolescents With NF1
official: Feasibility Pilot of a Cognitive Intervention for Children and Adolescents With Neurofibromatosis, Type 1
summary: Psychological interventions have been shown to be effective for managing cognitive and mental health challenges in different patient populations. The investigators are testing whether such a problem-solving skills program is effective and beneficial for children and teens with NF1 when implemented in a real-world setting. Unstuck and On Target! (UOT) is a comprehensive manualized intervention program that targets executive functioning (EF), self-determination, autonomy, quality of life, and mental health, as well as impact on parental stress. It has demonstrated effectiveness at improving EF in youth with autism. The investigators are assessing the effectiveness of the program in youth with NF1 and adapting the program for NF1, as needed, based on participant feedback.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Receive subject-informed consent;
* Youth with a diagnosis of NF1 and their parents;
* Youth aged 8-17 years old (inclusive) and their parents

Exclusion Criteria:

* Conditions that significantly affect cognition (e.g., intellectual disability diagnosis, active psychosis), hearing loss or vision problems precluding participation in group
* Non-English speaking
